dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures characterized by high-intensity perimeters enclosing lower-intensity cores, exhibiting a distinct gradient transition from the darker dorsal background to the bright perimeter boundary.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High concentration of saturated, localized high-intensity pixel clusters in the lateral-cervical region, with secondary discrete punctate blobs distributed along the mid-ventral margin.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent dorsal macro-annuli form a non-equilateral quadrilateral geometric relationship relative to the longitudinal axis of the torso.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced transverse high-contrast linear ridges in the cervical region and high-intensity specular reflection within the ocular aperture.
